note: The fuzzer-supplied DER PKCS#12 bytes become the datum decoded by the PKCS#12 implementation.
An encrypted safe from the input is copied into the first bag element for later decryption.
The encrypted-bag datum is freed before replacing the bag with decoded SafeContents, so the bag element must not retain this freed pointer on the error path.
If decoding the decrypted SafeContents fails or leaves stale element state, the caller continues cleanup of the same bag object.
The parse error path deinitializes the bag after decryption failed.
Cleanup reads the stale data pointer from the same bag element that was already freed during decryption, producing the heap-use-after-free read.
